title: Ensemble fallback reranker with locale-priority routing and KV warm-start
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Problem: Our single-model cross-encoder reranker occasionally regresses on non-en locales and has high p95 latency under bursty traffic. Goal: Implement an ensemble fallback strategy that prioritizes locale-specialized lightweight rerankers, routes requests based on locale/confidence, and warm-starts KV cache + prefix cache for the primary cross-encoder to reduce tail latency and token cost. This ticket covers model selection gating, runtime routing logic, and regression checks for quality and latency.
acceptance_criteria: Ensemble routing policy added: locale-aware primary -> locale-specialized fallback -> compact quantized fallback
End-to-end p95 latency reduced by >= 20% on test workload (multilingual, seq_len=128) compared to current baseline
Semantic NDCG@10 for sampled non-en locales does not degrade more than 1% vs current production reranker
Canary rollout with gradual traffic shifts and automated rollback if rerank quality metric drops > 2% or latency SLO violated
Integration tests added to CI that simulate cold-start KV cache and assert warm-start reduces first-request latency by >= 15%
tasks: Design routing policy document and fallback scoring weights (Aisha)
Add locale detection and enrichment hook in inference gateway (Diego)
Implement KV warm-start sequence to pre-load top-K prefixes for active locales
Integrate compact quantized cross-encoder variant as last-resort fallback
Create regression harness for multilingual NDCG / latency and wire into nightly checks
Define canary rollout playbook and add automated rollback triggers
test_plan: Unit tests for routing policy logic (locale + confidence thresholds)
E2E synthetic workload: multilingual queries mixture, compare p95 and cost/unit
Regression suite: run NDCG, recall@k on L10n datasets vs baseline models
Load test: burst traffic scenario to exercise fallback paths and autoscaler behavior
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal nightly job only (no customer traffic) - validate metrics
Phase 1: 1% traffic canary for low-risk customers (24h), monitor latency & NDCG
Phase 2: 10% traffic for non-critical regions (48h), test KV warm-start cache hit rates
Phase 3: 50% incremental increase with automated gating; full rollout after 7 days of stable metrics
notes: We will prioritize locale-fallbacks for languages with historical regressions (JP, KR, PT-BR)
KV warm-start budget: pre-load up to 500 prefix entries per active locale, configurable per deployment tier
Cost trade-off: ensemble increases model footprint; evaluate dedicated cache TTL and eviction heuristics
Will coordinate with Dedicated infra to validate memory/slot requirements for reserved pools
